semantic-conditional-target-ref:us-west-.note: Topic exists only when Dev holds. The validator and cfn-lint (W1001) both warn without rejecting.

semantic-cycle-conditional:us-east-1.note: Known divergence: the cycle exists only when Prod holds, which depends on a parameter. The validator reports a warning; cfn-lint ignores conditions and reports E3004.

semantic-cycle-conditional:us-west-2.note: Known divergence: the cycle exists only when Prod holds, which depends on a parameter. The validator reports a warning; cfn-lint ignores conditions and reports E3004.

semantic-cycle-exclusive-conditions:us-e.note: Known divergence: Prod and Dev compare Env with different values, so the resources never exist together and no cycle forms. Each DependsOn names a resource absent whenever its dependent exists; the validator warns because that depends on Env. cfn-lint reports E3004 and E3005.

semantic-cycle-exclusive-conditions:us-w.note: Known divergence: Prod and Dev compare Env with different values, so the resources never exist together and no cycle forms.
